name: @zhizhu/playwright-shell-contract
description: 知竹：Playwright shell 配置 browser_profile_slug / 默认起始地址 的共享校验（Electron 与 API 同步一致）

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const hasTsc=(()=>{try{return !!require.resolve('typescript/bin/tsc')}catch{return false}})();if(!hasTsc){console.log('[playwright-shell-contract] skip build: typescript not installed');process.exit(0);}cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});"
